buttons: Watch CaseThe 40 mm steel shell that locates and protects the movement

Minute HandThe long hand, turning once per hour
Seconds HandA light pointer showing the fourth wheel's rotation
Automatic RotorAn off-centre mass that winds as the wrist moves

Mainspring BarrelThe coiled energy store and its slow-driving drum
Centre WheelThe first large wheel of the going train

Escape WheelThe toothed gate that releases the train one step at a time
Pallet ForkA rocking lever between escape wheel and balance
Balance WheelThe oscillator that divides time into equal intervals
HairspringThe fine spiral that returns the balance toward centre
Ruby JewelsHard, polished bearings at high-value pivots and pallets
